caseStudies.title: Loom Crafts — Case Study
caseStudies.subtitle: Luxury Outdoor Furniture & Prefab Architectural Living
caseStudies.desc: Connecting premium furniture aspiration with high-confidence prefab architectural education.
caseStudies.heroImageCaption: Loom Crafts outdoor luxury furniture and modern prefab modular architecture.
situation: Loom Crafts operates across two very different categories — premium furniture and prefab/modular homes. One sells through aspiration and design; the other requires education, proof and confidence before purchase.
realChallenge: The challenge was to make both verticals feel connected while communicating them in completely different ways.
thinking: We built a two-track content system for the brand. Furniture communication focused on spaces, materials, lifestyle and design, while prefab content moved deeper into projects, factory processes, construction, installation and educational storytelling. We also extended the content system into D-ARC Bengaluru and the Raipur Open House through pre-event, on-ground and post-event communication.

work.title: Furniture Storytelling & Spatial Design
work.description: Furniture communication focused on spaces, materials, lifestyle, and design details to inspire aspirational home and resort living.
bullets: Spatial daylight staging and material textures
Luxury residential and resort placement
Aesthetic outdoor living narratives

work.title: Prefab Education & Factory Processes
work.description: Moved deeper into projects, factory processes, construction, installation, and educational storytelling to build high buyer confidence.
bullets: On-site assembly and factory walkthroughs
Buyer FAQ demystification and construction timelines
Engineering quality and architectural proof

work.title: Event Amplification (D-ARC & Open House)
work.description: Pre-event, on-ground, and post-event storytelling extending the content system into D-ARC Bengaluru and Raipur Open House.
bullets: D-ARC Bengaluru designer activations
Raipur Open House prefab walkthroughs
Multi-channel event digital coverage

gallery.caption: Loom Crafts handcrafted outdoor living design
Tactile weave and weather-resistant material craftsmanship
Modular prefab architecture and construction detail

caseStudies.closingQuote: Loom Crafts moved beyond product-led communication towards a more informative, visual and solution-led brand presence — giving customers a clearer understanding of both what the brand makes and how it delivers it.
caseStudies.closingText: Running a multi-vertical brand with different buyer needs? Let's talk.
caseStudies.challenge: Loom Crafts operates across two very different categories — premium furniture and prefab/modular homes. The challenge was to communicate both effectively without confusing audiences or diluting either brand.
caseStudies.whatWeDid: We built a two-track content system for the brand: one focused on craftsmanship, luxury and lifestyle for the furniture line, and the other focused on engineering, design and possibilities for the prefab architectural vertical. This was supported by process-led factory shoots, architectural documentation, and strategic exhibition coverage at D-ARC.
caseStudies.theResult: Loom Crafts moved beyond product-led communication towards a more informative, design-forward brand presence that clearly separates yet elevates both lines of business.
